dict.string:
Keeps Mac awake while on AC power. - caffeinate -s: Prevents sleep while plugged in - caffeinate -i: Prevents idle sleep (display can sleep) KeepAlive: Restart automatically if it dies
NOTE: Does NOT prevent sleep when: - Lid is closed without external display (clamshell mode) - Running on battery power
For additional control, manually run: - sudo pmset -c sleep 0 (AC: never sleep) - sudo pmset -c displaysleep 0 (AC: display never sleep) - sudo pmset -b sleep 5 (battery: sleep after 5 min) - sudo pmset -a hibernatemode 3 (disable hibernation)
To check current settings: pmset -g
